findings.title: Required checks and PR/review rules do not match the documented gates
evidence: ruleset 24481135 required_status_checks = ['Lab preflight / lab'] only; no `pull_request` rule
CONTRIBUTING.md:57-71 says main should require a pull request, one review, 'pack lint + self-test' and 'changed-run gate'
CODEOWNERS routes reviews but does not enforce them (.github/CODEOWNERS:1-7)
findings.impact: The pack's own P0/P1 run gate and lint/self-test are not enforced server-side; a direct push can land audit runs without them.
findings.recommendation: Add the pack CI contexts to the ruleset required checks and a pull_request rule with >=1 review.

findings.title: Required check 'Lab preflight / lab' is unobtainable for fork PRs
evidence: lab-preflight.yml:24-37 runs on pull_request paths including runs/**
lab-preflight.yml:59 needs a repository secret unavailable to forks
findings.impact: The single required check blocks all external contributions and is not the intended pack gate.
findings.recommendation: Make the required context a fork-safe pack check and run the lab check only on same-repo PRs/dispatch.

findings.title: Ruleset bypass actors permanently include the repository role and a deploy key
evidence: docs/security-style guidance elsewhere in the pack favors auditable exceptions (CONTRIBUTING.md:73-77)
findings.impact: Bypass actors remove the practical guarantee of the required checks for those actors.
findings.recommendation: Scope bypass to the digest deploy key only, and record owner-authorized exceptions.

report: Live state read via `gh api repos/MaineCyberTech/repo-deep-dive/rulesets/24481135` and `/branches/main/protection`. `main` is governed by an active ruleset `main-protection` (deletion + non-fast-forward + required status checks); the legacy branch-protection API returns 404 'Branch not protected'.
